semanticBoundaries.diagnosis: Instructional four-step reading, not a scored response.
semanticBoundaries.oneVariable: Each comparison keeps the named controls fixed and changes exactly one variable.
semanticBoundaries.bestValidation: Selects a saved checkpoint; does not prove mathematical convergence.
semanticBoundaries.terminal: Written kind/reason distinguishes model selection, safety, and mathematical convergence.
semanticBoundaries.finalSelection: Mathematical convergence eligibility is required before best-validation comparison.
semanticBoundaries.baseline: Endpoint-only check; no per-iteration solver comparison.
semanticBoundaries.provenance: Plotted curves are real Banknote runs; existing synthetic support examples remain separate and are not relabeled.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use the fully composed 65–72 second final frame/poster together with the transcript and summaries.
fallbacks.nonColor: Problem traces are dashed with square terminals, next traces are solid with circle terminals, diamonds mark best validation, and terminal kind/reason is written.
